Name: Tiny Wild Farm
Author: Lavliette
Description:
[u]Features[/u]
• Replaces the Wilderness Farm by default but can be changed via config
• No Daisyniko's Tilesheets required, so all recolours for 1.5 should work.

[u]Requirements[/u]
• For SDV 1.5 (no mobile support)
[u]
Installation[/u]
• Download this mod and open the .zip folder
• Put the unzipped folder [CP] Tiny Wild Farm into your Mods 
• Run the game with Smapi and select the  Wilderness Farm

Manifest.Description: A little farm for you and the monsters.
